trigger: PR23 routing showed LOAD_A_NEG at 198 segments/97.795 mm and LOAD_A_POS unroutable because raw load-cell test points were placed in the generic upper test-point band at Y=58.025 mm.

authority.device_evidence: HX711 is a precision 24-bit bridge ADC with low-noise PGA and Channel-A full-scale differential input in the tens of millivolts; relocating raw-input test points is an engineering inference, not an explicit manufacturer placement instruction.

engineering_inference: For LOAD_A_POS/LOAD_A_NEG, preserve the coupled quiet path from J_LOADCELL to U_HX and keep test-point branches short. The generic upper-band accessibility rule is subordinate to analog signal integrity for these two raw bridge inputs.

TP_LOAD_A_POS.role: raw load-cell positive test point; short branch above U_HX input side

TP_LOAD_A_NEG.role: raw load-cell negative test point; short branch above U_HX input side

routing_restart: After this ECO is merged, restart PR19A from clean main and route LOAD_A_POS/LOAD_A_NEG as a coupled quiet pair with short test-point branches.
